description.blurb: S/2004 S 21 is a natural satellite of Saturn discovered in 2004 and announced in 2019.
description.more: S/2004 S 21 is about 3 kilometres in diameter, and orbits Saturn at an average distance of 22,645 Gm in 1272.61 days, at an inclination of 160° to the ecliptic, in a retrograde direction and with an eccentricity of 0.318.​
